propositions: Leaf plans must have a Testing or Verification H2 section, or at least one AC item containing backtick-fenced code, or an AC item matching the verification vocabulary regex; plans lacking all three signals block on p10_verification_presence.

The ac_vagueness lexicon matches vague terms with word boundaries (excluding 'clean' term and handling 'etc.' with 30-character post-span exemption); matches inside recorded inline code spans never fire; p11_ac_vagueness applies only to AC item lines.
Vague lexicon matching errors (no word boundaries, 'clean' false positives) are eliminated by the fixed rule applied to both the new blocking p11 check and the advisory p6_ac_quality surface.
P6 remains advisory while p10 and p11 are separate blocking DET checks with independent coverage entries; existing P6 posture assertions remain unaffected.
Backtest over 304 passed plans and 55 blocked-plan hits demonstrated 0 false positives for the boundary-fixed lexicon and 4 blocked-plan overlaps for verification-presence logic.
Documentation of P10 and P11 deterministic-floor checks is added to docs/plan-review-gate.md.
